title: Michele Sindona's money laundering operation

tellings.quote: And it's used to do the world's biggest money laundering operation ever, 200 billion dollars according to the author Paul Williams.

plain: A financier named Michele Sindona is said to have been at the centre of the world's biggest money laundering operation, around 200 billion dollars, with the story dated to 1964. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels this, citing the figure to an author named Paul Williams. He also names the CIA's James Jesus Angleton and a Charles Hambro, linking the money to the secret networks behind the UFO cover-up he describes.
